description: This file defines the 'Constant' class in the TensorFlow Java API, providing static factory methods to create constant tensors of various data types, shapes, and encodings. It includes methods for creating constants from primitive values, arrays, buffers, and Java objects, encapsulating the TensorFlow 'Const' operation.

classes.name: Constant
classes.description: A final class representing a constant tensor operation in TensorFlow Java API, with static methods to create constants of various types and shapes, internally wrapping the TensorFlow 'Const' operation.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory methods to create Constant instances from primitive types, arrays, buffers, strings, and Java objects, supporting multiple dimensions and data types.

methods.name: createWithTensor
methods.description: Internal helper to instantiate a Constant from an existing Tensor.

methods.name: asOutput
methods.description: Returns the output of the operation for use in constructing other parts of the computation graph.
